Sareas is a playable character in the Grand Quest: The End of An Empire. He is the Third Prince of Bariura Empire, whose said to be "blessed with the beauty of heaven".

==History==

Sareas, who mastered the imperial archery since young age, is loved by the citizens during his father’s reign. However, he is known as a foul-mouthed person. [[Dure (character)|The Second Imperial Prince]] is the worst victim of his insults.

Sareas acts as the captain and he guards the East Gate during the Great War, which was predicted as the God Army’s first point of attack. While repelling the attack from [[Kajah (character)|a disciple]], Sareas finds himself in a dire situation. He would have lost his life if Dure doesn’t rushed back to save him. At first, Sareas is ungrateful to Dure’s action, even insulted his half-brother. But after Dure said that it was his duty as a brother, he starts to change.

==Character==

Looks cute and sweet from the outside, Sareas is actually a cunning and foul-mouthed person who likes to insult people, especially Dure. As one of the youngest children in the Imperial Family, Sareas has childish and impulsive side too, as shown in the Grand Quest, particularly in the run for the gold achievement.

==Relationships==
===Dure===
Dure is the victim of Sareas' insults. However, he started to see his older brother in a more positive way after the latter saves him from [[Kajah (character)|Kajah]]'s attack.
